notes:
Summary: inbound SMB (growth-stage martech + small ecommerce clients). Signed up self-serve, used hosted API only. Trial stalled after initial key -- only a handful of test calls; no integration into app. Signs of churn: low usage, competitor offered promotional credits, price pushback.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- CTO (J. Park): "Works fine for PoC but we need to see predictable cost at 10k+ messages/mo."
- Head of Growth: "If we can get a small promo to ramp devs we'll finish the integration."

Technical notes / issues:
- First key worked; after rotating keys they hit a 401 due to incorrect SDK config (RB-3421). Support applied fix 2026-02-07.
- No sustained traffic; highest daily tokens = ~1.2k. Typical day = 0-200 tokens.
- Use-case targeted: chat-based support widget (fast responses <150ms ideal for UI), product recommenders for PDP, and automated marketing copy. Latency desire: 100-200ms p95 for short responses; current hosted latency tests (our bench) show ~120-180ms on similar model.

Commercial / procurement signals:
- Budget small; prefers pay-as-you-go but open to small monthly commit if unit price drops. Estimated ARR target for vendor is <$5k/year — low ACV.
- Mentioned competitor discount (three months free) as main switching trigger.

Next steps recommended by AE:
- Offer 2-week credit top-up (one-time) and an in-product checklist for integration steps so devs don't stall on key rotation.
- Quick SE session: 45m pairing to integrate SDK into their Next.js storefront. Schedule tentative week of 2026-03-10.
- Provide simple cost-sensitivity examples (1k / 10k / 100k tokens) and suggestion to enable prefix caching to reduce tokens for chat.

CRM shorthand / recent touches:
- 2026-02-08: Slack nudge -> replied "will discuss with team".
- 2026-02-18: competitor promo noted.
- 2026-03-02: AE voicemail left.

Open risks / why at-risk:
- Small ACV makes this low priority internally; easy to be poached by promo credits.
- Developer friction (key rotation, lack of example integration) slowed adoption.
- Price sensitivity: will not commit to Dedicated.

Stated blockers (customer language):
- "We like the latency and output but need to hit volume economics. If you can’t beat promo I can’t justify switching."

Attachments / refs: pricing comparison doc (linked), support ticket RB-3421.
